achievements.name: Barrel Buddy
achievements.detail: Free Diddy, Dixie, or Cranky from a barrel and carry on together.

achievements.name: Spell KONG
achievements.detail: Collect the K, O, N, and G in one level and reach the goal so they count.

achievements.name: Puzzle Piece
achievements.detail: Pick up a puzzle piece hidden along a stage.

achievements.name: Secret Exit
achievements.detail: Leave a level through its secret exit and open the extra stage beyond it.

achievements.name: Mangrove Boss
achievements.detail: Defeat the boss of Lost Mangroves and take back the first island.

achievements.name: Six Islands
achievements.detail: Defeat the boss of every main island, from Lost Mangroves through Donkey Kong Island.

achievements.name: Temple Level
achievements.detail: Collect every KONG letter on an island and clear the temple level that unlocks.

achievements.name: Home Island
achievements.detail: Fight through Donkey Kong Island and defeat the Snowmads' leader.

achievements.name: Funky Clear
achievements.detail: Clear a level in Funky Mode while playing as Funky Kong.

achievements.name: Extra Art
achievements.detail: Gather puzzle pieces until another image unlocks in the Extras gallery.

achievements.name: Secret Seclusion
achievements.detail: After the temple levels and the last boss, clear the three stages in Secret Seclusion.

achievements.name: Two Hundred
achievements.detail: Finish every level in Hard Mode, with one heart and no checkpoints, for 200 percent.
